# telegram/budget-extension — M22 B2 smart auto-continue extension note

**Card:** M22 Wave 0 ("Fixtures first") baseline, regenerated by Wave
2's B2 budget-extension HUD note.

**What it pins.** The smart auto-continue `Continue` path
(`drive_turn::budget_decision`): when a full soft-cap block of tool
turns completes and the block made real progress (>= 1 successful,
non-read-only tool call), the budget silently extends by another block,
up to the hard ceiling. Every pre-existing fixture ran with
`hard == soft` (extension disabled), so this path had never been
reachable through replay. This fixture is the first to split the caps —
`max_tool_turns: 2` (soft) and the new manifest knob
`max_tool_turns_hard: 8` — and pins what the user now sees at each
extension: a one-shot HUD note. The first extension's `extended tool
budget (2/8 turns)` note rides exactly ONE running HUD frame (the next
live frame after the block boundary). The second extension fires right
before the final no-tool turn, so its `(4/8 turns)` note never gets a
frame in this run — `finalize` re-queues it through the B1 notice
machinery, pinned here by asserted absence. Still no checkpoint chat
row, and the run still does NOT stop at the soft cap.

**Shape.** One telegram group message drives a five-turn scripted
provider: four sequential `shell` tool calls (`echo progress one` …
`four` — successful and non-read-only, so each block latches
`made_progress`), then the final text.

- Turns 1-2 complete the first soft-cap block → `Continue` (silent).
- Turns 3-4 complete the second block → `Continue` (silent).
- Turn 5 returns the final text and ends the run normally.

Telegram's live HUD runs alongside (`model_rich_breadcrumbs: true`, as
in `hud-transcript`), so `expected/messages-out.jsonl` also pins the
B5 step transcript accumulating on every frame and exactly one frame
carrying the extension note.

**Assertions** (in `tests/replay.rs`,
`telegram_budget_extension_notes_extension_on_hud`, on top of the
byte-stable JSONL diff): all five provider requests arrived (the soft
cap extended rather than stopped), the HUD reached the past-soft-cap
`4 tool calls` count, the extension note rides exactly one running HUD
frame (and never a chat row), the unrendered second note is absent, and
no outbound row carries the stop-and-ask wording ("hard ceiling" /
"send 'continue'" / "no visible progress").

**Regeneration.** `COPPERCLAW_M22W0_GENERATE=1 cargo test -p
copperclaw-host --test replay telegram_budget_extension -- --nocapture`.
